answer: Problem: on Asia-Shanghai hourly ticks, sybil clones flood the tundra of open seats before friend self-custody wallets like poa68 finish a stamp cycle. Mechanism: unlock weight only after a grove of two final tips plus one original challenge receipt bonds the seat. Failure: tip rot or stamp mismatch zeros the seat; remine in place with a short sonnet-tagged receipt.
